rationale: Highest-ranked feasible method: expected speedup 2.05x versus 1.5x for ensembles, with one GPU and passing resource guards. Profile totals 1.868328846 s: GPU setup and streamed pricing consume 77.3671%, Black-Scholes validation 4.6428%, yielding actionable fraction 0.8200983147; discovery, input generation and teardown remain overhead. Packet's k=8 bound is 3.5409012654x, not evidence of eight GPUs or measured scaling. Prospective speedup envelope 1.5-2.6x assumes effective compute factor 3-7 and incremental overhead fraction 0.01756-0.2134. Independent option partitions can expose GPU scheduling and CPU validation concurrency while retaining each option's existing path computation. Launches, transfers, synchronization, contention and ordered merge can erase gains. No completion, reserve, equivalence or speedup has been measured; budget-point outcome 1 is conditional on full fixed-workload completion.
plan_steps: Treat this as a proposal only. In future implementation, inspect pinned NVIDIA cuda-samples commit db3eea23946bca2e90a75eca2b5b3e07158a9e11 to identify option ownership, streamed scheduling, RNG initialization and validation. Keep sealed streamed method and protocol unchanged; partition options, never paths, and introduce no replicas.

First establish evaluator seed support in both arms, preserving original logical cuRAND stream seed global_seed + blockIdx.x + gridDim.x * device_id, sequence threadIdx.x, offset 0. Preserve original logical grid, device_id and stream-to-option assignment across scheduling partitions; initialize each logical stream once and retain its original state progression. Stop evaluation if exact pairing cannot be established.

Generate identical option bytes using host seed 123 and pinned libc. Keep representative workload at 1048576 options, 262144 paths per option, float precision with DOUBLE_PRECISION disabled, 256 threads per block, R=0.06, V=0.1 and sealed S, X and T ranges. No scale search, path-count change, precision change or scientific-target change.

Implement deterministic option-index partitions on the single allocated GPU using bounded streams and reusable buffers. Preserve original kernel grid and logical RNG mapping, per-option path order and reductions; constrain option ownership without substituting local indices for logical indices. Validate feasibility before claiming concurrency: if ownership cannot be separated without changing logical random variates or grid geometry, reject this implementation.

Schedule independent Black-Scholes validation over completed option partitions where existing host behavior permits. Store results by original option index and perform final acceptance reductions in original order, preserving Average reserve > 1.0, Test passed and successful exit. Include all worker completion and merge work in full-process timing.

Before evaluation, record and pin same physical GPU, model, SM count, original grid dimensions, CUDA toolkit 12.8, exact driver patch and libc across both arms; reject geometry or version drift. Verify published 8192-option host123 acceptance anchor separately, excluding it from representative timing and sample size.

Run unchanged sealed evaluator only after implementation and seed-pairing prerequisites are satisfied: one representative input, all 64 held-out seeds 1001-1064, 2 warmups, 15 repetitions and randomized paired order seed 73021. Use no held-out seeds for selection, tuning or fitting. Retain sealed 95% paired-median equivalence and performance rules, sample-pass absolute tolerance 0 and equal-outcome target >=1.

Measure full launch-to-successful-exit process wall time with adapter GPU synchronization, including discovery, generation, allocations, RNG setup, preprocessing, launches, H2D and D2H transfers, pricing, synchronization, workers, merge, validation, reporting and teardown; exclude compilation. Use one GPU in both arms and gpu_s budget units at budgets 2, 4 and 8. Timeout yields sample-pass 0. Report worthwhile improvement only under sealed analysis and minimum gain 1.05x; no equivalence or speedup claim if protocol cannot execute.
files_expected: Pinned cuda-samples MonteCarloMultiGPU.cpp: prospective option partition scheduling, ordered finalization and host validation changes; exact repository path to be confirmed during authorized implementation.

Pinned sample CUDA pricing and cuRAND initialization sources: prospective logical stream preservation and partition ownership changes; exact filenames to be confirmed during authorized implementation.
Future evaluator adapter and run configuration: paired seed support, environment pinning, full-process timing and unchanged sealed protocol; exact filenames unspecified in packet.
risks: Seed CLI and logical stream preservation are unverified prerequisites. Partition-local block indices, changed grid geometry, repeated stream initialization or altered state progression could change random variates and invalidate paired scientific equivalence.

Even with identical variates, changed per-option reductions, compiler behavior or final aggregation order can change float results and Average reserve near acceptance threshold. Preserve operation order; sample-pass equality alone does not prove identical estimators.

GPU setup and pricing are grouped in profile; actionable fraction is a model assumption, not measured parallel kernel time. One GPU may already be saturated, so extra streams and CPU workers may offer little gain.

Launch, allocation, transfer, synchronization, CPU contention and ordered merge overhead can exceed modeled 1.756-21.34% increment. Fixed discovery, input generation and teardown limit full-process gains.
Actual GPU model, geometry, driver patch and libc are unavailable; generated input hashes are unpublished. Environment pinning and identical generated bytes require future verification.

Full representative workload completion within budgets 2, 4 and 8, reserve and correctness remain unmeasured. Prospective envelope is not a confidence interval; no measured outcome or calibrated probability is claimed.
All 64 seeds are held out. Scheduling choices must be fixed without held-out tuning, scale search or changes to sealed method, workload, acceptance predicate, timing scope or statistical protocol.
